parser.classificationBasis: matchPart recognizes the exact source contour name as soma; the parser maps border.soma to somaContour while retaining closed=false. The zero-value CellBody property is verified as a separate evidence gate.

closureInterpretation.scope: File-specific soma cross-section line closure only; source name drives independent soma classification and the empty-value property is a separate evidence gate.

displayContract.admittedPrimitive: source-native MBF cell-body ordered LineLoop only
forbiddenInferences: native drawing width as SWC diameter

contours.closureBasis: MBF cell-body semantics applied to exact source name + empty-value CellBody property + independent somaContour; raw sourceClosedFlag remains false
